This has been my favorite photo editing app for years and since I use it almost daily I didn’t even mind paying the monthly subscription cost for all the features until recently. It has become more and more glitchy over the past couple of months. I have to constantly close out the app because photos go blank or will not save without reloading. I’ve had edited photos straight up disappear off the app. Customer support does not help and you can see from the replies to reviews that the developers do not care, they just tell people to open a support ticket that will go nowhere or give them instructions on how to cancel their account. I will be looking for an alternative since it’s impossible to get help or any kind of answers as to what is going on and if it will even be fixed. Very sad to have to do it but I can’t keep paying for an app that is becoming more and more unusable and terrible customer service.

reviews.title: Devs ignoring all the bad reviews and couldn’t care less about the original users
reviews.text: I had VSCO since it first appeared on the App Store, bought most of the filters which are excellent. Then the subscriptions came along, I upgraded, was paying a yearly subscription on top of all the money I’d paid initially for the filters. Then they introduced a pro version on top of that, features that were once free became locked behind a paywall, no consideration for the original users who backed this app from the start and helped it grow in popularity, all they care about is money, Its no longer a photography community and has had a serious fall from grace. I’ve since cancelled all the subscriptions because quite frankly there are much better apps out there for photo editing, the features are very limited and the whole app is very laggy and bugs out so often it’s laughable (despite it being on my iPhone 17 Pro Max), literally been ran into the ground by greedy developers who’s only response is ‘sorry to see you go, please click this link for a refund’. I genuinely hope the app gets boycotted by more people for what they have done and how they have no loyalty to those who invested in them to begin with. If you’re going to charge so much on top of what you’ve already charged at least make the app the best there is. Deleting it and won’t be coming back unless they address this greediness.

reviews.title: Ads will kill this app.
reviews.text: VSCO was game changing when it first came out. The first social media that didn’t rely on likes or selfies or followers. It was a space for people to share their true selves with friends with no other factor in what was posted. Allowing ads was a complete sell out. Not only is the ad frequency so heavy that you can’t see three post without an ad in between, but they have allowed too much for it. You’ll get stuck on the ads forced to see them, they will play audio that doesn’t stop once you scroll, if you touch on the ad it will sometimes have some sort of interaction with the ad so that it’s moving the ad but not scrolling past. I have been on vsco for many many years now and have had multiple accounts at the same time. This has literally caused me to stop going on there as much. As soon as I see an ad I close it out anymore. You are literally making your own app obsolete by selling out to these ad companies. Mind you, every platform has ads, but they aren’t so in your face, disrupting the  atmosphere created on the app. Before this, this app would be categorized with the big ones; Snapchat, instagram, Facebook. Now I am borderline disgusted by the ads and how much freedom you have given them. This was not customer forward thinking.
